matches.title: Tierlist of all HC + Evo Towers
matches.snippet: Tierlist of all HC + Evo Towers 9. Brawler. Decent for speedrunning. That's all. 8. Necromancer. Very map and mode dependent, great for HC, VC and PW2, but pretty useless besides that. 7. Accelerator. Outclassed by every DPS tower except Turret and Pursuit. 6. Engineer. Jack Of All Trades, Master Of None. Struggles in early-game, mid-game and late-game, very support-unfriendly, was useful in LHC and LFM, but not in their modern versions. 5. Operator. Extremely good early, and holds up pretty well till the late game, but has alternatives like G Soldier, which can be even better. 4. Enforcer. Map and modes dependent (sucks in Frost, shines at Pizza Party and Fallen). Crazy damage and CE plus stuns, though short range. 3. Hacker. The only good HC tower. Multiple strong abilities, very versatile and useful, can increase your DPS drastically with it's clones and doesn't even need to be upgraded to level 5, but is very expensiive and loadout-dependent. 2. Juggernaut. Extremely good for mini/final boss/bosses and for overall damage on Bottom Path, and very strong support and Cost Efficient on Top Path + has hidden and flying/lead. Kingpin. Crazy DPS, strong eco, versatility, 2 detections + 1 semi-detection. Good practically everywhere.

matches.title: Why juggernaut is doodoo DPS slop
matches.snippet: Why juggernaut is doodoo DPS slop No seriously, it used to look like a good choice but now it just looks so incredibly grindy when other, actually viable evos came around. Jugg is quite literally just good for it's "DPS", which you have to pay half a million just to even make it a reasonable choice. It's not a bad tower, but it's heavily outclassed by other evos like Kingpin and the recent Enforcer. Not only that, but the "10k DPS" claim is sheer exaggeration. no one, especially a solo player where it's most efficient will have many supports, but even if they do get all the specs somehow, your loadout is literally just Juggernaut and Friends. You should not complain about the game, or modes in general being boring or "bad" if your playstyle is being Elon musk for 20 waves and placing Jugg. I don't hate Jugg. It's a good tower, but it's just incredibly brain-dead to use. saying your favourite tower is Jugg is the equivalent of saying "infinity + 1". Again, it's good for some hard modes like Voidcore. But I am not bringing jugg to play frost.

matches.title: TDS vs TB (Not to cause controversy)
matches.snippet: TDS vs TB (Not to cause controversy) Coming from a post by Gaming With Noobs, and as a fan of both games, i will compare the towers both games have in common. Scout They both hold pistols, are the starter tower of the game, have the same name, and dual wield later on. Even if you take in the appearances, the concept and idea are the same, Doesn't matter if a guy with a pistol has a nicer design than another guy with pistol, both are still dudes with pistols. Sniper Snipers in both games, have the same name, use a sniper rifle, and EVEN LAY DOWN. both also ARE DEFAULTLY GREEN. If this isn't a blatant copy, I don't know what is. Even if you compare stats, deep down, you know it's a copy. Soldier Although Planet3arth gave permission, my personal opinion states they should've changed more things. I was personally fine with Soldier in TDS's early stages being completely identical, as a prototype, i'm really in the middle with the fact that TDS's soldier, just like TB, holds an M16, has a burst mechanic, and is also basically the 3rd starter tower, but it's definitely not original. Freezer/Cryogunner -both are shitty -both use an ice gun -designs are way similar -both freeze enemies but stop at bosses -not an inspiration Farm -Name's the same -carrot/potato/wheat field is original but the trees aren't. apple trees definitely stray away but THE FUCKIN' BLUE GLOWY TREES AT MAX LEVEL. -

verified_top_matches.snippet: Tierlist of all HC + Evo Towers 9. Brawler. Decent for speedrunning. That's all. 8. Necromancer. Very map and mode dependent, great for HC, VC and PW2, but pretty useless besides that. 7. Accelerator. Outclassed by every DPS tower except Turret and Pursuit. 6. Engineer. Jack Of All Trades, Master Of None. Struggles in early-game, mid-game and late-game, very support-unfriendly, was useful in LHC and LFM, but not in their modern versions. 5. Operator. Extremely good early, and holds up pretty well till the late game, but has alternatives like G Soldier, which can be even better. 4. Enforcer. Map and modes dependent (sucks in Frost, shines at Pizza Party and Fallen). Crazy damage and CE plus stuns, though short range. 3. Hacker. The only good HC tower. Multiple strong abilities, very versatile and useful, can increase your DPS drastically with it's clones and doesn't even need to be upgraded to level 5, but is very expensiive and loadout-dependent. 2. Juggernaut. Extremely good for mini/final boss/bosses and for overall damage on Bottom Path, and very strong support and Cost Efficient on Top Path + has hidden and flying/lead. Kingpin. Crazy DPS, strong eco, versatility, 2 detections + 1 semi-detection. Good practically everywhere.

verified_top_matches.title: Why juggernaut is doodoo DPS slop
verified_top_matches.snippet: Why juggernaut is doodoo DPS slop No seriously, it used to look like a good choice but now it just looks so incredibly grindy when other, actually viable evos came around. Jugg is quite literally just good for it's "DPS", which you have to pay half a million just to even make it a reasonable choice. It's not a bad tower, but it's heavily outclassed by other evos like Kingpin and the recent Enforcer. Not only that, but the "10k DPS" claim is sheer exaggeration. no one, especially a solo player where it's most efficient will have many supports, but even if they do get all the specs somehow, your loadout is literally just Juggernaut and Friends. You should not complain about the game, or modes in general being boring or "bad" if your playstyle is being Elon musk for 20 waves and placing Jugg. I don't hate Jugg. It's a good tower, but it's just incredibly brain-dead to use. saying your favourite tower is Jugg is the equivalent of saying "infinity + 1". Again, it's good for some hard modes like Voidcore. But I am not bringing jugg to play frost.

verified_top_matches.snippet: TDS vs TB (Not to cause controversy) Coming from a post by Gaming With Noobs, and as a fan of both games, i will compare the towers both games have in common. Scout They both hold pistols, are the starter tower of the game, have the same name, and dual wield later on. Even if you take in the appearances, the concept and idea are the same, Doesn't matter if a guy with a pistol has a nicer design than another guy with pistol, both are still dudes with pistols. Sniper Snipers in both games, have the same name, use a sniper rifle, and EVEN LAY DOWN. both also ARE DEFAULTLY GREEN. If this isn't a blatant copy, I don't know what is. Even if you compare stats, deep down, you know it's a copy. Soldier Although Planet3arth gave permission, my personal opinion states they should've changed more things. I was personally fine with Soldier in TDS's early stages being completely identical, as a prototype, i'm really in the middle with the fact that TDS's soldier, just like TB, holds an M16, has a burst mechanic, and is also basically the 3rd starter tower, but it's definitely not original. Freezer/Cryogunner -both are shitty -both use an ice gun -designs are way similar -both freeze enemies but stop at bosses -not an inspiration Farm -Name's the same -carrot/potato/wheat field is original but the trees aren't. apple trees definitely stray away but THE FUCKIN' BLUE GLOWY TREES AT MAX LEVEL. -Both give cash every wave Demo -Both throw grenades -Names are INCREDIBLY similar -Both use goggles -Both are cheap -Only difference is that one uses a grenade launcher at max. Hunter/Marksman Alright, I've gotta give it to TDS this time, since hunter came out first, still though, hunter is just shitty sniper on the floor. Aviator/Ace Pilot -Both have old-school plane designs at low levels -Get more modern as it gets upgraded -BOTH EVEN DROP BOMBS AT LEVEL 2 -BOTH GET LASERS AT MAX -BOTH HAVE SPY PLANE GRANT AND GET HIDDEN DETECTION -TB comes out on top for this one Flamethrower/Pyromancer So, both use flamethrowers, that's a given. Both get gas masks when upgraded, yeah that's a given, Just the concept of Flamethrowers weren't exactly invented by TB, but TDS did copy everything except that dual wield. Minigunner/Commando Literally the same fucking thing, -Level 1 = gloves -Level 2= goggles -Level 3= second minigun -Level 4 = lasers Now guess which unit i was describing, exactly. THE FUCKING SAME. Old TDS minigun was more original than now, by one factor, a jetpack. OoOHohoH uPgRaDE 3 dOessN'T giVe a SeConD gUn. It gives a second minigun barrel, doubling/ quadrupling it's DPS, which is basically the same as TB. Commander/Commander and DJ Booth/DJ Both are literally the fuckin' same. I agree that Call To Arms is from Bloons Tower Defense though. BUT, Both commanders stand on stools, are by default, navy blue, wear a hat, have medals, hold walkie talkies, Pull out lugers when CTA is used, give buffs, have sunglasses, and have a crest on their hat. Only difference is that TB Commander can spawn Strykers and Airstrikes. DJ is the EXACT FUCKIN SAME. Both give buffs, and eventually discounts at later stages, can play custom music with a gamepass, have the same style, and look the exact same at max. The differences between the two are that the firerate and range buffs are switched between the two towers. and through this, I have manifested an opinion that "Gaming With Noobs" has never played tower battles. Shotgunner/Shotgunner The fact that shotguns weren't invented by either TDS or TB completely nullifies both arguments here. Militant/Mercenary Both units here use automatics, only dividing factors are different models and RELOADING, militant is kinda shitty tho. Concept is the same. Patrol/Military Base Concepts are the same, both ram units with cars, and eventually get to tanks. Laser tanks are original though. Enforcer/Warden The same. Concept is the same, both are Police Officers, both get hidden detection when upgraded, get stun sticks on upgrade3, and get decked out in swat gear at max. only difference is that the actual stun stick model comes to TDS at max level, and the levels one and two for TDS are just levels one and two from TB but switched up. Electroshocker/Stunner -I don't use either tower, but both use tasers -Both Stun with electricity -Instead of a helmet, Electroshocker gets a stun tower, so yeah its inspired. Ranger or Outlaw/Railgunner Levels 0-2 for Railgunner were blatantly copied, The mounted gun levels 3-4 were not though, Outlaw was obviously copied, Ranger is a more realistic version of Railgunner, removing the bullet trail that lingered. Accelerator/Phaser -Both use blue lasers at base -Accel gets a visor similar to phaser's when upgraded -Both become purple at max level -Both lock on and are considered the best DPS in the game Pretty much a copy. Mortar Mortars weren't invented by BTD, TDS, or TB. so cancelled out. Frost Blaster/Sleeter Both are minorities and no one cares. Golde
